thesis: Changing decisive facts changes the diagnosis in educational retrieval, rewritten books, replacement code and fake editions.
role: Test the method through four fictional cases.

ideas.statement: Educational purpose and purchased copies do not settle each retrieval act; open licences can exclude embedded components.
New wording, passing tests or independent branding each answer only part of a dispute; protected expression, independence and misleading affiliation need separate evidence.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The cases are teaching exercises, not court predictions or safe harbours.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
